**LEGAL NOTICE**  

**(In the matter of Recovery of Rent Arrears – Leave & Licence Agreement)**  

---

**To,**  

Mr. S. Kulkarni  
Flat No. — [Address]  
Kothrud, Pune – 411038  

**Date:** 24 October 2026  

---

### **Subject:** Demand for Payment of Rent Arrears and Security Deposit – Notice under the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999  

---

#### **1.  Parties**

1.1. **Our Client:** Mr. R. Deshmukh, residing at Flat No. [‑] , Kothrud, Pune (hereinafter referred to as the “Lessor”).  

1.2. **Addressee:** Mr. S. Kulkarni, residing at the premises described above (hereinafter referred to as the “Licensee”).  

---

#### **2.  Facts**

2.1. A registered Leave & Licence Agreement (the “Agreement”) was executed between the Lessor and the Licensee on **1 April 2023**, whereby the Licensee was granted the license to occupy the flat situated at Kothrud, Pune for a monthly licence fee of **Rs 15,000** (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only).  

2.2. The Agreement expressly provides that the licence fee shall be payable on or before the **5th day of each calendar month**.  

2.3. The Licensee paid the licence fee duly for the months of **April 2023 to April 2025**.  

2.4. The Licensee has **failed to pay the licence fee for the months of May, June, July, August, September and October 2025**, amounting to a total arrear of **Rs 90,000** (Rupees Ninety Thousand only).  

2.5. The Lessor has made the following demands for payment:  

    (a) Two oral demands on **12 May 2025** and **15 June 2025**;  
    (b) One written reminder via WhatsApp on **20 July 2025**.  

All such demands have been **ignored**.  

2.6. A security deposit of **Rs 45,000** (Rupees Forty‑Five Thousand only) was handed over by the Licensee to the Lessor at the time of execution of the Agreement and is being retained as per the terms of the Agreement.  

2.7. The Agreement is governed by the **Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999** and the laws applicable in the State of Maharashtra.  

---
